summary: Fortress Credit Realty Income Trust filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report its net asset value per share as of March 31, 2026. The filing provides a detailed breakdown of NAV by class, total NAV of approximately $1.321 billion, and underlying components. This is a routine periodic disclosure of NAV for a nontraded REIT, not a special situation. No event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring is announced. The filing serves as standard reporting to shareholders and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
